description: Answering a closed-paths question before drafting a new ADR: the history skill must prune the tree's ADRs to the queried topic, extract closed paths from both surviving Alternatives bullets and the bodies of Revises commits, run its one bounded model step to keep only the on-topic candidates and to collapse a path recorded in both sources into one entry preferring the in-tree Alternatives bullet, and report exactly the on-topic closed paths with each one's reason and source — never surfacing a non-revising Clarifies edit and never surfacing an off-topic ADR's rejected alternative.
